_note: Simulated inventory layer for portfolio demonstration only. All values below are assumptions, not company data. 'methods' selects the model; the Phase 3A model is methods = fixed_range / volatility_factor / top_up / coverage_only.

policy_band._used_when: methods.inventory = policy_band (Phase 3B-1): current inventory = reorder point + p x EOQ, with p drawn per SKU. p = 0 is the reorder point, p = 1 is the maximum stock (just after a delivery); p < 0 is below the reorder point and p > 1 is above the maximum.

safety_stock._volatility_factor: Phase 3A: lead-time demand x (base_factor + cv_factor x min(CV, cv_cap))
safety_stock._service_level: Phase 3B-1: z(service level) x monthly demand std x sqrt(lead time / days_per_month)

order_quantity._eoq: Phase 3B-1: sqrt(2 x annual demand x ordering cost / (unit cost x annual holding rate)), rounded up and capped at max_order_coverage_days of demand

overstock._coverage_only: Phase 3A: coverage above coverage_days, only for the listed classes
overstock._max_stock: Phase 3B-1: inventory above max(reorder point + EOQ, coverage_days of demand), all classes
